title: OTHRYS OS Panda-style context header and live status repair
goal: Repair the missing live-status DOM target and tighten the Panda-style project context header without changing authority.
laws: Live/offline status must have a real DOM target before render touches it.
Context header distinguishes selected project presentation from canonical branch truth.
No connection control or network action is added.
Offline rendering must fail visibly rather than throwing on a missing element.
Canonical branch remains main and is not rewritten by local project context.
Existing read/control token boundaries remain unchanged.

slices.title: Polish context header and status display
